cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: IIM Indore will release CAT 2026 admit cards on November 4 (NDTV Profit). Registered candidates can download them on iimcat.ac.in using their login credentials. The exam date and slot timings were not in the summary we read; they will be printed on the admit card and listed on iimcat.ac.in.
